english:
Psalm 97 [98]: "They have seen". Catholic [Epistle], 2 Peter 3:1: "This, beloved... to verse 9... repentance." Alleluia, Psalm 92 [93]: "The Lord reigns." Gospel, John 6:39: "And this is the will... to verse 12... of the twelve."

In the Evening, the first Gospel, Matthew 14:24: "But the boat... to verse 35... [from the foundation of the] world."
Mesedi: "The Lord reigns," "They appeared."
Hambartsi [Hymn of the Ascent] Tone 2 [b]: "Today they rejoiced," and "The wondrous women," and "Coming early." Dismissal Gospel, Mark 6:7: "And he went round about... to verse 13... they healed them."

On Saturday, Tone 2 [bk]: "Pharaoh." Canticle [Harts], Tone 7 [g3]: "You who are from eternity." Morning Gospel, Luke 11:14: "And he was casting out a mute demon... to verse 52... is here." Midday Psalm 62 [63]: "O God, my God," "As beloved," "You were pleased." Acts 16:6: "And they went through... to verse 40... and they departed." Psalm 66 [67]: "God be merciful unto us." Catholic [Epistle], 2 Peter 4:10: "But the [day of the Lord] will come... to verse 18... unto eternity, Amen." Alleluia, Psalm 6 [or 99/100]: "Sing joyfully to God." Gospel, John 7:1: "After these things... to verse 14... for fear of the Jews."

In the Evening, the first Gospel, Matthew 13:36: "Then leaving... to verse 52... new and old." Mesedi: "Blessed is he who comes," "The Lord our God." Hambartsi [Hymn of the Ascent] Tone 8 [dz]: "Being King." Dismissal Gospel, Mark 6:14: "And he heard... to verse 23... in a tomb."

The Fifth Sunday: Feast of the Apparition of the Holy Cross. Tone 7 [g3]: "Helper." Canticle [Harts], Tone 7 [g3]: "Today through the clouds," with its canon. Magnificat [Metsatsoogthe], Tone 7 [g3]: "Mother of Light." Morning Song: "You gave fear." "Holy God," who was crucified. After "Holy God," they shall go in procession with Cross and Gospel, singing the Hymn, Tone 7 [g3]: "Power of the Holy." Psalm 96 [97]: "They shall declare," response, "The Lord reigns." Epistle of Cyril [to the Emperor], "To the God-loving King." Apostle, Galatians 6:14: "But far be it from me... to verse 18... brethren, Amen." Alleluia, Psalm 4: "There has been signed." Gospel, Matthew 24:30: "And then shall appear... to verse 36... the Father only." And they shall bless the four corners of the world [Antastan]. Litany: "By this Holy Cross." Prayer: "Protect [us]," and all else is of the Resurrection. Morning Gospel, Luke 11:33: "No one [lights a lamp]... to chapter 12:12... it is necessary to speak." Midday Psalm 85 [86]: "Incline [your ear], O Lord," "His foundations," "Lord God." Acts 17:1: "And passing through Amphipolis... to verse 15... and they went." Psalm 64 [65]: "To you is due praise." Catholic [Epistle], 1 John 1:1: "That which was from the beginning... to verse 16... dwelling in us." Alleluia, Psalm 147: "Praise, O Jerusalem." Gospel, John 7:14: "About the middle of the feast... to verse 23... on the Sabbath."

In the Evening, the first Gospel, Matthew 14:53: "And it came to pass... to verse 58... their unbelief." And then they shall go in procession with Cross and Gospel, singing the Hymn of the Cross in Tone 5 [g]: "Tree of Life." After, Psalm 4: "There has been signed," response, "When I called." Gospel, John 19:25: "And there stood by the cross... to verse 30... he gave up his spirit." And they shall bless the four corners of the world [Antastan]. Litany: "By this Holy Cross." Prayer: "Protect [us]." And upon returning: "Incline [your ear]" and "Save [us]." Mesedi: "Come and see," "Our God is a refuge." Hambartsi [Hymn of the Ascent] Tone 7 [g3]: "Glorified is," and "With an awesome voice." Dismissal Gospel, Mark 6:30: "They gathered... to verse 44... five thousand."

Monday, Tone 6 [gk]: "Sing." Canticle [Harts], Tone 7 [g3]: "By your voluntary." Morning Gospel, Luke 12:13: "Someone from the crowd said... to verse 31... shall be added to you." Midday Psalm 88 [89]: "Your mercies," "Lord [you have been our] refuge," "He who dwells." Acts 17:16: "Now while [Paul was waiting] in Athens... to verse 34... others with them." Psalm 64 [65]: "To you is due praise." Catholic [Epistle], 1 John 2:1: "My little children... to verse 6... even as he walked." Alleluia, Psalm 147: "Praise, O Jerusalem." Gospel, John 7:24: "Do not judge by appearances... to verse 36... you cannot come."

In the Evening, the first Gospel, Matthew 14:1: "At that time... to verse 12... they told Jesus." Mesedi: "Our God in heaven," "At the going out." Hambartsi [Hymn of the Ascent] Tone 6 [gk]: "Your resurrection," and "Taking also our." Dismissal Gospel, Mark 6:45: "And immediately... to verse 56... were saved."
